e.title: SuperGLM
e.summary: 保险定价惩罚 GLM（PyPI 0.30.0，MIT）：group lasso/P-splines/Tweedie、可信度项、单调样条、交互筛选
e.summary_en: Penalised GLMs for insurance pricing (PyPI 0.30.0, MIT): group lasso/P-splines/Tweedie, credibility terms, monotone splines, interaction screening
e.summary_hk: 保險定價懲罰 GLM（PyPI 0.30.0，MIT）：group lasso/P-splines/Tweedie、可信度項、單調樣條、交互篩選
e.body: SuperGLM（StrudelDoodleS，PyPI 0.30.0，MIT，2026-08 活跃）是保险定价的惩罚 GLM 实现：group lasso（分组定价）、P-splines、Tweedie 分布、可信度项（credibility terms）、单调样条约束、交互筛选（interaction screening）、REML 求解、成本索赔（cost claims）——现代保险定价回归的完整工具箱。对 RIAA：惩罚 GLM 的现代实现——[[easy-glm]]（LASSO GLM 自动化）的深度版；group lasso 天然适配分组定价（factor 组）；P-splines 平滑（[[insurance-gam]] 的回归样条路线）；可信度项与 [[insurance-credibility]] 集成；与 [[insurancerating]]、[[aglm]]（精确 GLM）配套；适合定价回归建模方向。
e.body_en: SuperGLM (StrudelDoodleS, PyPI 0.30.0, MIT, active 2026-08) is a penalised GLM implementation for insurance pricing: group lasso (group pricing), P-splines, Tweedie distributions, credibility terms, monotone spline constraints, interaction screening, REML solvers, cost claims — a complete toolbox for modern insurance pricing regression. For RIAA: a modern implementation of penalised GLMs — the deeper version of [[easy-glm]] (LASSO GLM automation); group lasso naturally fits group pricing (factor groups); P-splines smoothing (the regression-spline route of [[insurance-gam]]); credibility terms integrate with [[insurance-credibility]]; pairs with [[insurancerating]], [[aglm]] (accurate GLM) ; suits pricing regression modelling.
e.body_hk: SuperGLM（StrudelDoodleS，PyPI 0.30.0，MIT，2026-08 活躍）是保險定價的懲罰 GLM 實現：group lasso（分組定價）、P-splines、Tweedie 分佈、可信度項（credibility terms）、單調樣條約束、交互篩選（interaction screening）、REML 求解、成本索賠（cost claims）——現代保險定價迴歸的完整工具箱。對 RIAA：懲罰 GLM 的現代實現——[[easy-glm]]（LASSO GLM 自動化）的深度版；group lasso 天然適配分組定價（factor 組）；P-splines 平滑（[[insurance-gam]] 的迴歸樣條路線）；可信度項與 [[insurance-credibility]] 集成；與 [[insurancerating]]、[[aglm]]（精確 GLM）配套；適合定價迴歸建模方向。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI 0.30.0 + 文档站（group lasso/P-splines/可信度项），未实测
